Franchise tax, motor vehicle tax and contributions use their own categories; remaining 'other'/miscellaneous lines carry review. No transfers appear. Beginning cash is the governmental funds beginning fund balance (279,722) since no separate beginning cash is shown; ending cash 339,066 is total governmental funds balance (cash + CDs + county treasurer cash; fund balance equals total assets). Business-type rolled forward on net position (modified cash); revenues = operating revenue 248,742 + interest income 5,579; expenses = operating expenses 318,621 + net interest expense 2,474 + loan/bond fees 37,261 = 358,356 (matches statement of activities p2); both totals marked computed. Printed Water interest expense is +13,862 (likely sign error in the report; p8 cash flow shows interest paid 13,862); total (2,474) used as printed. Business-type BAN proceeds 425,000 and principal repayments 438,116 (p8) are not in the net position roll-forward. Cash-flow statement exists but basis is cash so proprietary is null. Balance sheet is the government-wide Total column (p1). Note: top-level General government 80,688 (p5) is a function total and differs from the sum of detail lines mapped to general government.
